# HEVC non-reference AVD control coverage map

**AI disclosure:** This file, including its title and all prose, was generated by AI.

Bounded research for [omarchy-m1-video#66](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/66).
It inventories HEVC SPS/PPS/scaling/decode/slice/entry-point fields consumed
by patched `avd-hevc.c` that the schema-2 campaign did **not** measure, and
names a CRA-window follow-up capture. Parent
[libva-v4l2_request#42](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/42)
keeps the actual RPS_E correction.

`decoded_frame_evidence=false`. This does not fix RPS_E, raise 144/147, or
declare firmware guilty.

## Reproduce from a fresh checkout

Ordinary Linux, Python 3, a C compiler. No `/dev/video*`, sudo, installer or
private media.

1. Campaign identities (needs the pinned userspace checker, not this repo):

```
# tests/hevc-reftrace-check.py at libva-v4l2_request ba66572ff7e1e380377eb2414a7eb7d7f97bb0d9
# SHA-256 666eacdde663e8ef890a0e974f5f0ce0f857803b25558b5e56db8f775f9d7dfa
HEVC_REFTRACE_CHECKER=/path/to/hevc-reftrace-check.py \
  python3 experiments/hevc-avd-trace/campaign-report.py --verify
```

2. Hash-locked Asahi sources and the 15 shipped patches (no hooks, no module
   build required for this leaf):

```
python3 experiments/hevc-avd-trace/fetch.py /tmp/avd-pristine
# apply only patches/0001–0015 with fuzz 0, p6, onto a new directory
# expected avd-hevc.c SHA-256 417cd4c0d39957ab6a281b706acb298c08e5132888e8cad2a6edf5d2673824f9
# concatenated patch SHA-256 029f57377a00f3584678f80a8011d8ba7a17c83f1708d9a429d3c91dbb2d0390
# kernel 94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea
HEVC_AVD_HEVC_C=/tmp/avd-15patch/avd-hevc.c \
  python3 experiments/hevc-avd-controls-map/validate.py --source "$HEVC_AVD_HEVC_C"
```

`prepare.py` also applies experimental `hooks.patch`; do not use that tree as
the inventory source. This leaf inspects the shipped 15-patch `avd-hevc.c`.

3. Offline tests (CI):

```
python3 experiments/hevc-avd-controls-map/validate.py --self-test
```

## What is classified

| Class | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `already_measured` | schema-2 public B/E evidence around pictures 24–34 (reference/motion/layout/slice count/entry count/dependent flag) |
| `statically_derivable` | constant or purely arithmetic from pinned C (for example `HEVC_SCL_DIMS`, tile prefix sums). Not firmware-validated. |
| `missing_runtime_input` | consumed in source but absent from public captures. Do not fill with zero. |
| `outside_scope` | absolute DMA, scratch/pipe_state, compressed bytes, firmware |

Pictures 24–34 comparison uses only published campaign facts. Unknown full VA
controls, scaling matrices, weights, offsets and bitstream preparation stay
unknown. Inactive I-slice flags that the I branch does not consume are not
treated as causal.

## Decision

The installed client/recorder **cannot supply full VA controls**. A later
experimental hook must dump preamble SPS/PPS/scaling/QP/deblock/weight words
in the existing 24–34 window, centred on the RPS_E CRA at decode picture 28.
See [next-observation.md](next-observation.md). Rank compressed-reference
and firmware-state work after that audit.
